svg.title: How Shura works
svg.desc: ShuraCode talks to the AI Gateway on port 8080 over the OpenAI API; the gateway spawns and proxies llama-server on port 8090, which uses the GPU for attention, the MTP head, hot experts and the KV cache, and RAM for cold experts and the prompt cache. ShuraCode also talks to Playwright and SearXNG over MCP.
